title: 第25章 运筹帷幄结束第26章 初识修真者
content_zh:
追梦把柳城的难民问题解决了，但这一年，旱灾如恶魔般笼罩了披萨国西边，受灾面积竟达大半个披萨国。
披萨国难民四处迁移，经常为了一口吃食拳脚相加，有人卖儿卖女，有人上山为匪，甚至有人异子而食，有肇事者揭竿而起占山为王，披萨国西边大半个国家一片混乱，已经有灭国危机时迹象。
追梦出于仁慈博爱之心，向披萨国国王捐献了一百万两黄金，以救济难民，为国王化解了危机。
国王更是喜出望外，直接将柳城的邻城羊城分封给追梦，并顺势将邹家村所在的区域也一同赐予追梦。
自此，邹铁牛荣升羊城城主，追梦成为少城主，柳淼花则贵为城主夫人，皆为有头有脸的人物。
追梦在自己的封地上，精心打造出一座崭新的主城，名为邹城，并将羊城纳入邹城的管辖范围。
新的邹城乃是一座一星顶级县级主城，城内已有10个一级门派，若非缺乏筑基期高手，已然可以晋升为2星县级主城。
邹城是以邹家村为核心构建而成的，其主要收益来源于精盐销售所带动的产业链。
故而，许多来自邹城外的商队或者商团，皆将邹城称作盐城。
追梦在邹城施行了一系列政策，让邹城人口快速饱和。
第一，之前柳城的十几万难民没有住房，追梦把水泥钢筋搞了出来，在邹城修建了大片大片的房屋。
当然，追梦家修建的房屋不是免费送的，难民居住需要满足几点。
1、是家中至少要有一个人在邹家干活。
2、难民买房邹家帮助全额贷款，只需要首付1两银钱就行，买房的银钱后面从难民干活的月酬中扣，但需要签定契约，难民如果中途无故断扣月酬，或者贷款额未还清，房屋所有权还是属于邹家。
3、买房的难民只要一直在邹家干活，满十年，邹家奖1两黄金，满二十年，邹家奖5两黄金，满三十年，邹家奖10两黄金，以此类推。
房价分普通房1百两黄金一套，中等房5百两黄金一套，上等房1千两黄金一套，豪华房1万两黄金一套，贵宾房10万两黄金一套。
对此，追梦特意计算过，对与一个普通人来说，适合购买1百两黄金一套的普通青砖瓦房，需要在邹家干活二十年就可以还清。
如果是夫妇两人一起在邹家干活，普通的青砖瓦房十年就可以还清。
如果是中等房，夫妇俩一起的话，也就二十五年就可以还清。
4、难民想得到邹家的全额贷款买房，还需要在邹城登记好详细的信息，并办理完邹城入住身份证。

第二，只要有难民或者其他地方来的人，购买邹城的房，邹家承包安排工作。
第三，邹家在邹城修建了两个平民学院。
一个是男子学院，只招收男子。
一个是女子学院，只招收女子。
两个学院都负责教导人启蒙识字、历史文化、诗词歌赋和修炼武功。
同样的，也是最重要的，学员想进入这两个学院，就必须要在邹城买房。
第四，追梦在邹城修建了两座大型的医院。
这两座医院分别是，平民医院和贵人医院。
在平民医院，只要在邹家干活的佣人，享受四折优惠，其家属享受六折优惠。
在邹城购房的平民，也享受七折优惠。
贵人医院医治的贵人，主要指的是在邹家干活的管理人员。
这些管理人员，享受四折优惠，其家属享受六折优惠。
第五，邹家在邹城开办了大型的交易市场，追梦把精盐销售总部从阿弥彦皇朝搬到邹城，凡在邹城来购买精盐的商队，或者商团不再受到购买精盐数量上限的管制。
随着这些政策的落地生根，在追梦家劳作的难民犹如久旱逢甘霖的禾苗，纷纷住进了青砖瓦房，难民的子女也如同展翅高飞的雄鹰，迈入了平民学院的殿堂，其生活水平已然可与地主员外相媲美。
在这一进程中，追梦家以高薪为饵，大肆招揽佣人，这些佣人犹如勤劳的蜜蜂，马不停蹄地修建着青砖瓦房和学院。
难民们为了能获得高薪工作，让子女有机会进入学院，只得忍痛购买追梦家修建的高价青砖瓦房。
难民们所挣的银钱看似颇为丰厚，但在购房面前却犹如杯水车薪，远远不够。
无奈之下，他们只得向追梦家求助，请求追梦家慷慨解囊，全额贷款。
而这贷款额，则将从他们每月的薪酬中扣除。
如此一来，追梦家犹如坐收渔利的渔夫，不仅收获了源源不断的劳动力，更拥有了取之不尽的财富。

content_en:
Chasing Dreams solved the refugee problem in Liucheng, but this year, drought enveloped the western part of Pizza Country like a devil, with the affected area reaching more than half of Pizza Country.
Refugees from the Pizza Country move around, often fighting for a bite of food. Some sell their children and daughters, some go to the mountains to become bandits, some even eat their children, and some perpetrators rise up to take over the mountains and become kings. Most of the country in the west of the Pizza Country is in chaos, and there are already signs of a crisis of national annihilation.
Out of kindness and fraternity, Zhui Meng donated one million taels of gold to the King of Pizza Country to relieve refugees and resolve the crisis for the King.
The king was so overjoyed that he directly entrusted the neighboring city of Liucheng, Yangcheng, to Zhui Meng, and also granted the area where Zoujiacun was located to Zhui Meng.
Since then, Zou Tieniu has been promoted to the city lord of Yangcheng, Chai Meng has become the young city lord, and Liu Miaohua has become the city lord's wife. They are both prestigious figures.
Chai Meng carefully built a brand new main city on his own land, named Zoucheng, and brought Yangcheng under Zoucheng's jurisdiction.
The new Zoucheng is a one-star top county-level main city. There are already 10 first-level sects in the city. If it were not for the lack of foundation-building masters, it could be promoted to a two-star county-level main city.
Zoucheng is built with Zojia Village as its core, and its main revenue comes from the industrial chain driven by the sale of refined salt.
Therefore, many caravans or business groups from outside Zoucheng call Zoucheng Yancheng.
Zhuimeng implemented a series of policies in Zoucheng, which quickly saturated Zoucheng's population.
First, hundreds of thousands of refugees in Liucheng had no housing before. Zhuimeng took out cement and steel bars and built large tracts of houses in Zoucheng.
Of course, the houses built by Dream Chasers are not given for free, and refugees need to meet several requirements to live there.
1. At least one person in the family must work in the Zou family.
2. The Zou family helps refugees buy a house with a full loan. They only need a down payment of 1 tael. The money to buy the house will be deducted from the refugee’s monthly salary, but a contract needs to be signed. If the refugee’s monthly salary is deducted for no reason midway, or the loan amount is not repaid, the ownership of the house still belongs to the Zou family.
3. As long as a refugee who buys a house has been working in the Zou family for ten years, the Zou family will be awarded 1 tael of gold, for 20 years, the Zou family will be awarded 5 taels of gold, for 30 years, the Zou family will be awarded 10 taels of gold, and so on.
Prices are divided into ordinary rooms with 100 taels of gold per set, medium rooms with 500 taels of gold per set, superior rooms with 1,000 taels of gold per set, deluxe rooms with 10,000 taels of gold per set, and VIP rooms with 100,000 taels of gold per set.
In this regard, Zhui Meng specially calculated that for an ordinary person, it is suitable to buy an ordinary brick house with 100 taels of gold, and it can be paid off by working in the Zou family for twenty years.
If a couple works together in the Zou family, an ordinary brick house can be paid off in ten years.
If it is a mid-range house, the couple can pay it off in twenty-five years.
4. If refugees want to get a full loan from the Zoucheng family to buy a house, they need to register detailed information in Zoucheng and apply for a Zoucheng move-in ID card.
Second, as long as refugees or people from other places purchase houses in Zoucheng, the Zou family will arrange the work.
Third, the Zou family built two civilian colleges in Zoucheng.
One is a men's college that only admits men.
One is a women's college that only admits women.
Both academies are responsible for teaching people enlightenment literacy, history and culture, poetry and poetry, and martial arts practice.
Similarly, and most importantly, if students want to enter these two colleges, they must buy a house in Zoucheng.
Fourth, Zhuimeng built two large hospitals in Zoucheng.
The two hospitals are the civilian hospital and the noble hospital.
In the civilian hospital, servants who work for the Zou family enjoy a 40% discount, and their family members enjoy a 40% discount.
Common people who buy houses in Zoucheng also enjoy a 30% discount.
The nobles treated by Guiren Hospital mainly refer to the managers who work in the Zou family.
These managers enjoy a 40% discount,Their families enjoy a 40% discount.
Fifth, the Zouchen family opened a large-scale trading market in Zoucheng, and Zhuimeng moved the refined salt sales headquarters from the Amiyan Dynasty to Zoucheng. All caravans or business groups that came to buy refined salt in Zoucheng were no longer subject to the upper limit on the quantity of refined salt purchased.
As these policies took root, the refugees who worked in Dream Chasers were like seedlings that experienced drought after a long drought and moved into brick houses one after another. The children of refugees were like soaring eagles and entered the halls of civilian colleges. Their living standards were already comparable to those of landlords.
During this process, Dream Chasers used high salaries as bait to recruit servants. These servants were like hard-working bees, building brick houses and colleges non-stop.
In order to obtain high-paying jobs and give their children the opportunity to enter college, the refugees had no choice but to buy high-priced brick houses built by Dream Chasers.
The money earned by the refugees seems to be quite generous, but it is like a drop in the bucket when it comes to buying a house. It is far from enough.
In desperation, they had no choice but to seek help from the Dream Chasers, asking them to generously provide a full loan.
The loan amount will be deducted from their monthly salary.
In this way, dream chasers are like fishermen reaping profits. They not only harvest a steady stream of labor, but also possess inexhaustible wealth.
